news.title: Vicky Kaushal Sports a Bold Look in Love and War Poster
news.summary: The promotional campaign for Sanjay Leela Bhansali's Love And War continues with the release of Vicky Kaushal's character poster. The actor appears in an intense and confident style, holding a cigar. The film, which also stars Ranbir Kapoor and Alia Bhatt, is slated to hit theatres on January 21, 2027.

news.title: Hombale Films Takes Over South Release for Hanuman Ansh
news.summary: Kannada banner Hombale Films has secured the complete South theatrical rights for the successful small-budget movie Hanuman Ansh. Plans for a release through Trivikram Srinivas's production house were previously shelved. The movie, directed by Vishal Chaturvedi, will soon arrive in Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, and Malayalam.

news.title: NTR to Attend Don't Trouble The Trouble Pre-Release Event as Chief Guest
news.summary: Young Tiger NTR is set to grace the pre-release event of the upcoming film Don't Trouble The Trouble as the chief guest. Directed by Shashank Yeleti and starring Fahadh Faasil, the movie is scheduled for release on October 2, 2026. The project is backed by Arka Media, presented by SS Rajamouli, and features music by Kaala Bhairava.

news.title: Chiranjeevi Uses Humorous Jab To Address Online Trolls At Sigma Pre-Release Event
news.summary: Megastar Chiranjeevi brought his signature wit to the Hyderabad pre-release event for Sigma by lightheartedly addressing social media memes claiming he blocks others' growth. He playfully quipped about actress Faria Abdullah missing a dance opportunity with him in Vishwambhara, turning online gossip into a cheerful stage moment. The action-adventure heist film, directed by Jason Sanjay and starring Sundeep Kishan alongside Faria, is slated to arrive in theaters on October 2, 2026.

news.title: Megastar Chiranjeevi Confirms Sankranti 2027 Arrival For Upcoming Movie Kaaka
news.summary: Actor Chiranjeevi has given a fresh production update regarding his project Kaaka, assuring fans that it remains on track for a theatrical release during Sankranti 2027. He noted that the entire first half and about thirty percent of the second half are already filmed, pushing overall completion to roughly seventy percent. Directed by Bobby and featuring music by Thaman, the father-son action drama is locked for release on January 13, 2027.

news.title: Vicky Kaushal Reveals Rugged 1960s Soldier Look For Sanjay Leela Bhansali's Love And War
news.summary: Actor Vicky Kaushal has shared his striking first-look poster for Sanjay Leela Bhansali's upcoming directorial venture, Love & War. The promotional image features the actor with facial injuries, holding a vintage lighter, and sporting a dramatic wartime aesthetic. Co-starring Ranbir Kapoor and Alia Bhatt, the multi-starrer period drama is scheduled to hit global screens on January 21, 2027.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Smashes Records To Enter The 100 Crore Club In Two Days
news.summary: Srikanth Odela's directorial venture The Paradise has crossed the 100-crore milestone globally, generating over 114 crore in worldwide gross within just two days of release. This achievement marks the fastest entry into the century club for actor Nani. Backed by producer Sudhakar Cherukuri, the period action drama is performing strongly across domestic regions and international markets alike.

news.title: Megastar Chiranjeevi's Kaaka Accelerates Toward Sankranti 2027
news.summary: Megastar Chiranjeevi revealed that his upcoming project Kaaka, directed by Bobby Kolli, is moving forward at a rapid pace with the entire first half and nearly thirty percent of the second half already completed. Speaking at a pre-release event, the actor confirmed the film remains on track for a Sankranti 2027 theatrical arrival while noting that music director S Thaman has already commenced background score work for the first portion.

news.title: Taapsee Pannu Recalls Being Dropped Due to Lead Actor's Spouse
news.summary: Actress Taapsee Pannu shared one of the most unusual experiences of her career, revealing that she was replaced in a film after her dates had already been finalized because the leading man's wife disliked her. She noted that such abrupt removals disrupt meticulous scheduling and cause actors to miss out on alternate professional opportunities.

news.title: Mythri Film Distributors Face High-Stakes Test Across Multiple Major Releases
news.summary: Mythri Film Distributors are undertaking a massive financial gamble in the Nizam region by acquiring high-profile projects like The Paradise, AK47, Jailer 2, and Ranabaali over a tight four-week window. Despite previous setbacks and mixed initial reactions to certain titles, the distribution firm is leveraging partnerships to distribute risks while aiming to solidify its regional presence.

news.title: The Paradise Maintains Resilience in Telangana While Experiencing Declines Elsewhere
news.summary: Natural Star Nani's starrer The Paradise brought in approximately nineteen crores gross on its second day, driven by a stellar performance in Telangana that brought in nine crores gross. Although overseas territories and Andhra Pradesh registered steep declines, the solid hold in the Nizam region prevented a more severe overall box office slump.

news.title: Venkatesh and Trivikram's Aadarsha Kutumbam Shifts Date and Preps Special Track
news.summary: The family entertainer starring Venkatesh under Trivikram's collaboration has moved its theatrical arrival from October 2 to October 9. Consequently, the promotional schedule shifted, delaying the release of its opening track penned by Ramajogayya Sastry and sung by Ram Miryala and Prabha. This upcoming special musical piece features leading actors including Srinidhi Shetty, Nivetha Pethuraj, and Dimple Hayathi alongside the main lead.

news.title: Nani and Team Address The Paradise Response Following Strong Opening Box Office
news.summary: Actor Nani and director Srikanth Odela faced the media promptly after mixed initial reactions greeted their latest collaborative venture. Despite heavy online trolling, the movie managed a massive opening day gross exceeding ₹75 crore and maintained decent second-day occupancy. The core team gathered for a press interaction alongside notable figures like Mohan Babu to discuss the feedback and evaluate the upcoming weekend trajectory.

news.title: Megastar Chiranjeevi Expresses Enthusiasm for Jason Vijay's Directorial Debut Sigma
news.summary: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay's son, Jason Vijay, is launching his directorial career with the upcoming bilingual film Sigma, scheduled for an October 2 release. During the grand Telugu pre-release event where Chiranjeevi served as the chief guest, the veteran actor shared his excitement to watch the movie. The project features Sundeep Kishan and Faria Abdullah in the primary roles alongside a diverse supporting cast.

news.title: Preity Mukhundhan Lands Female Lead Opposite Dhanush in D56
news.summary: Actress Preity Mukhundhan has secured a major role opposite Dhanush in his 56th feature film, tentatively titled D56. The project officially commenced production with a traditional opening ceremony at the Karuppanasamy Temple in Sivaganga district. Helmed by director Tamizharasan Pachamuthu, the venture is jointly bankrolled by Sithara Entertainments and Primark Productions.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Faces Steep Decline Overseas After Record Debut
news.summary: Actor Nani's latest movie, The Paradise, registered an impressive $2.3 million on its opening day in international territories. However, the overseas collections dropped significantly on day two, bringing the two-day total to $2.55 million. The sharp decline follows unfavorable reports and reviews from international markets.

news.title: Keerthy Suresh Starrer Dorothy Sparks Debate Over Controversial Queer Theme
news.summary: Keerthy Suresh traveled to the Toronto International Film Festival to promote her Tamil film Dorothy, directed by Karthik Subbaraj. Following its theatrical release, the movie drew heavy social media trolling and divided audiences due to its handling of a queer theme and its second-half narrative. Despite the mixed reactions and criticism over its climax, the film also earned praise from certain critics and sections of viewers.

news.title: Megastar Chiranjeevi Amuses Internet With Self-Deprecating Joke at Event
news.summary: Megastar Chiranjeevi addressed online trolling and the viral 'Boss tokkesaadu' narrative with a humorous remark at the Sigma pre-release event. Joking with Faria Abdullah about restricting his growth, the actor proved he closely monitors social media discussions. Chiranjeevi is currently shooting for the Bobby-directed film Kaaka, slated for release in Sankranthi 2027.

news.title: Chiranjeevi Compares Sundeep Kishan's Drive to His Early Years at Sigma Event
news.summary: Megastar Chiranjeevi praised Sundeep Kishan at the pre-release event of Sigma for his dedication to picking fresh scripts. The action heist drama, directed by Jason Sanjay and backed by Lyca Productions, is scheduled to hit theaters on October 2 with Mythri Distributions handling the Telugu release. Chiranjeevi commended the lead actor's ambition and highlighted S Thaman's musical score as a major asset for the movie.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Sustains Momentum Despite Mixed Reception
news.summary: Nani's latest movie, The Paradise, managed to defy expectations by avoiding a sharp box-office drop on its second day. Trade figures indicate that the non-holiday worldwide gross surpassed Rs. 20 crores, backed by stable performances in the Nizam territory. While the opening weekend is expected to remain decent across Telugu states, trade analysts noted that stronger initial word-of-mouth could have elevated the final outcome.

news.title: Vijay Deverakonda Sports a Fierce Warrior Avatar in New Ranabaali Poster
news.summary: The creators of the pan-India historical drama Ranabaali have released a dramatic new poster showcasing Vijay Deverakonda in a rugged warrior stance. Directed by Rahul Sankrityan and produced by Mythri Movie Makers, the film is officially set for a worldwide theatrical premiere on October 16, 2026, coinciding with Vijayadashami. Set against the backdrop of 19th-century British rule, the project also stars Rashmika Mandanna in a prominent role.

news.title: Chiranjeevi and Bobby Kolli's Kaaka Commences Dubbing with Traditional Rituals
news.summary: Following their collaboration on Waltair Veerayya, Megastar Chiranjeevi and director Bobby Kolli have officially kicked off dubbing sessions for their upcoming action film Kaaka with a pooja ceremony. Produced under KVN Productions by Venkat K. Narayana, the movie is moving quickly through its post-production phase alongside ongoing shoots. The big-budget action entertainer is slated for a worldwide release during the Sankranthi festival on January 13, 2027.

news.title: Keerthy Suresh's Tamil Project Sparks Online Debate Over Intimate Themes
news.summary: Keerthy Suresh's latest Tamil venture, Dorothy, has drawn intense social media scrutiny due to its LGBTQ themes and intimate sequences between male characters. While director Karthik Subbaraj and the lead cast face online backlash from a section of viewers, urban audiences have appreciated the movie for exploring a sensitive topic.

news.title: Jr NTR Expected to Boost Visibility for Fahadh Faasil's Upcoming Telugu Venture
news.summary: The upcoming Telugu film Don’t Trouble The Trouble, featuring Fahadh Faasil in his Telugu lead debut, is preparing for a grand theatrical release presented by SS Rajamouli. To elevate public interest and boost promotional hype, the makers have lined up a pre-release event featuring Jr NTR as the chief guest.
